notes.title: SlavicPunk: Oldtimer launches on consoles today!
notes.content:
Hi,

The wait is over! SlavicPunk: Oldtimer is now available not only on PC but also on your favourite consoles. Dive into the brutal world of SybirPunk today on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X.

Prepare to survive in an unforgiving dystopia, a unique Slavic vision of cyberpunk where humanity clings to existence amidst ruthless oppression, violence, and a relentless chill.

[previewyoutube=moyvog7yXZQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Step into the shoes of Yanus, a private investigator facing off against urban gangs, powerful corporations, and his inner demons. Navigate a gritty world shaped by post-Soviet architecture and sharp Slavic humor. Known for its blend of fast-paced combat, customizable weapon upgrades, and immersive storytelling, SlavicPunk: Oldtimer brings a refreshing Eastern European take on the cyberpunk genre.

Key Features: 
 Fast-paced isometric combat with modular weapon upgrades
 Hacking mechanics and environmental puzzles
 A distinct dystopian setting inspired by Eastern European influences
 An engaging story crafted by acclaimed Polish sci-fi author Michał Gołkowski, creator of the SybirPunk universe 
The console version of the game includes all patches and updates from the PC version, including the Anniversary Update. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654060/499c9b154d5281499fd56dbc832c0b3e7c5ebfdc.png

SlavicPunk: Oldtimer releases on consoles at 04:00 PM your local time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654060/fd70dff932e57062479fe62a9cb3317d17c88e25.png

If you have questions or want to chat about the game, join our Discord server! Good luck on your mission, comrades.

notes.title: Anniversary update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654060/0f5f6e6f1dc06a1e5eb465d284fdf683fd7cdfc3.jpg
It has been exactly one year since the release of SlavicPunk: Oldtimer on PC platforms, and the development team at Red Square Games has decided to celebrate this anniversary by publishing a very important update for the game. This update addresses issues reported by the players and also includes a significant enhancement: the game engine has been upgraded from Unreal Engine 4 to version 5.3. This upgrade has improved the quality of the project and will enable further development of this Slavic universe.

As a team, we are hopeful that this update will breathe new life into the game, generate stronger interest from the gaming community, and lead to a reassessment of the product with an increase in positive reviews. We have put a lot of work into this project and want players to see us as developers who do not abandon their work but are committed to its future growth.

In addition to the game update, which will be released on June 27, 2024, we have another surprise: the game will be available for purchase on Steam at a 60% discounted price.

Important information:
We regret to inform you that due to the engine update and work on the save system, it will not be possible to load existing game progress from saved files. Unfortunately, the updated technologies require starting the game anew.

We understand that this may be frustrating and apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. However, we want to assure you that these changes are necessary to improve performance, stability, and add new features that will ultimately enrich the gaming experience.

We thank you in advance for your understanding and support in this matter.

Below are the detailed information about the Anniversary Update:
Patch Notes - Slavicpunk: Oldtimer Transition to Unreal Engine 5.3

 Updated Game Engine: The upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.3 brings significant improvements to graphics, physics, and development tools, allowing us to create more complex and realistic worlds.
 Performance Improvements: Optimizations in the game code and the use of new UE 5.3 features have significantly improved performance on various hardware configurations.
 Loading time reduction: Improvements in resource management and level optimization have reduced game loading times and transitions between locations.
 Game Stability: Resolved numerous game crash issues, especially during intense action scenes.
 Enemy AI: Enemies now behave more naturally thanks to improved artificial intelligence algorithms.
 Reactions to the player: Enemies respond better to the player's actions, which makes the gameplay more dynamic and realistic.
 Translation improvements: Updated and improved translations in various languages, eliminating errors and ambiguities.
 Keymapping: Added the ability to fully remap the keys on the keyboard and gamepad, allowing players to customize the controls to their own preferences.
 Default controls: Updated default controls to be more intuitive and in line with industry standards.
 Animation Smoothness Improvement: Thanks to optimizations and new EU 5.3 technologies, character and object animations are now more fluid and realistic.
 Animation bug fixes: Fixed numerous animation display bugs, such as objects clipping and characters getting stuck.
 Improved Save System: Improved the reliability of the game's save system, reducing the risk of losing progress.
 Controller Configuration: Enabled more advanced controller settings, including sensitivity and dead zone calibration.
 Achievement System Fixes: Fixed issues with recording achievements earned, ensuring all trophies are awarded correctly.
 


Summary
A total of approximately 100 bugs related to gameplay, enemy behavior, performance, level optimization, control options, location, etc. have been fixed. Every aspect of the game has been thoroughly analyzed and improved to ensure the best possible experience for players.

In terms of gameplay, issues that could affect the smoothness and satisfaction of the game were identified and fixed. The logic of interaction between characters has been improved, making the game more intuitive and addictive.
Enemy behavior has also improved significantly. Changes have been made to their artificial intelligence. Enemies now react better to the environment and player tactics, which increases the difficulty and realism of fights.

Game performance has been optimized, which includes better management of system resources and minimized lag. Thanks to this, players with different hardware configurations can enjoy smooth and stable gameplay.

Level optimization was a key aspect that contributed to improving the overall quality of the game. The number of unnecessary objects was reduced and the geometry of the environment was improved, which had a positive impact on loading times and smooth gameplay.
Control options have been expanded and adapted to the needs of different players. The ability to personalize the keys has been introduced, which allows for better adaptation of the game to the individual preferences of users.

The game's localization has also been improved. Corrections have been made to the translations to make them more precise and natural in different languages. This makes the game more accessible to players from different regions of the world.
Each of these aspects of the game has been carefully analyzed and improved, resulting in a much better gameplay experience for all players.

notes.title: Major patch 1.1.0 released!
notes.content:
SlavicPunk: Oldtimer Patch note 1.1.0: Upgrades, people, upgrades!

Dear Players,
We present to you the latest patch for SlavicPunk:Oldtimer, where we've been hard at work ironing out kinks and polishing the game to shine like chrome. We may be a small development team, but we take our craft seriously, and after reading all the reviews, we're committed to providing you with an exceptional gaming experience.

General Improvements:

Performance Boost: We've diligently optimized the game to enhance overall performance. Due to it being the most frequently reported issue, we dedicated the most attention to it. Our computer wizards did everything in their power to ensure that noticeable improvements are made in this patch, and this is not their final word.

DLSS: We're thrilled to announce the addition of DLSS technology, which injects a dose of magic into the visuals. Enjoy crisper graphics and improved performance, provided your hardware supports it.

Bug Fixes:
Story and Messages: Cutscenes are now equipped with subtitles.

Enemy Spawning: Even the toughest delinquents haven't mastered the challenging art of teleportation just yet. They should now spawn according to plan, allowing you a chance to prepare a warm welcome.


What’s to come?

After taking care of the most pressing matters, we are currently committing our resources to the following subjects:

Key rebinding
Bug Squashing
Tutorial enhancements
Subtitles, logs, and on screen communication between characters

We hope these updates will assure you of our unwavering commitment to your gaming satisfaction. What’s a party without a few broken bottles, right? It will be only better from now on.

Sincerely,
Red Square Games

notes.title: 'SlavicPunk: Oldtimer' patch announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players!

As a team, we want to apologize for all the inconvenience in some areas of the game, especially performance issues in some outside locations. Accept our sincerest apologies, some issues were simply out of our control. 

We know which aspects of our game require additional polish and/or fixes, and that's precisely what we're working on right now. Our main objective is for you to enjoy "SlavicPunk: Oldtimer" to its' true potential and we'll do what's necessary to make sure that's the case

We'll do whatever it takes not to let you down and convince you to give "SlavicPunk: Oldtimer" another shot. Bugs and issues are frustrating - that's why resolving them remains our top priority. The first patch will be published within days, so stay tuned

notes.title: Limited crowdfunding PRE-ORDER for SibirPunk RPG in the SlavicPunk universe.
notes.content:
On February 22nd at 0600 CET, Gamefound launches its crowdfunding campaign for SlavicPunk universe game that will only last until March 16th 0800 CET.

The game in question is the tabletop SibirPunk RPG that we are aiming to fund in its English language version together with a number of collector items.

Since the SibirPunk RPG world is part of the same universe as our SlavicPunk: Oldtimer video game, we have decided to create an opportunity for a cross-promotion of the two games.

For those who are not overly fond of tabletop RPGs, but still want to support our action through an earlier purchase of a Steam key for the SlavicPunk: Oldtimer video game, we have prepared a special Add-on with the video game key preorder.

1. Select the 1 EUR reward
2. Click the video game key Add-on

Nevertheless, we still encourage you to support and buy the RPG game as well - it is going to make a mighty fine addition to your collection of video game gadgets and curios!

Video game Steam keys for our backers will be delivered at the latest on the day of the official Steam game release - taking place as early as Q2 this year.

Everyone is welcome to join in and support our campaign!

Below, please find the link for our campaign preview where you may take a look at the action even before it begins.
https://gamefound.com/projects/red-square-games/sibirpunk-rpg
